title: Does having vulnerable friends help vulnerable youth? The co-evolution of friendships, victimization, and depressive symptoms in Chinese adolescents' social networks
descriptions: The dataset of the “Peer Relationship among Chinese Adolescents Project” focuses on Chinese adolescents' academic, social, and emotional development and their relationships with peers, parents, and teachers.
